method: Hash the exact static error in current platform source and compare with the preserved HTTP response fingerprint; no new POST and no private response text read
static_source_error: Historical task version has no recorded seed selection; cannot reproduce starting data
json_serialization: UTF-8 JSON object with one detail string, separators comma and colon, no trailing newline

bounded_read_only_census.policy: First 20 lexicographic train task keys in the frozen dense-dev20-v4 split outside the historical 100-task campaign; exact selected versions, no score selection

repair: Reject absent starting-data identity during GET-only eval/RL preflight and runtime revalidation. Remove the obsolete exception that deferred missing provenance to instance creation.
limits: The exact old task is not repaired or replayed; held results remain unchanged.
A matching error fingerprint diagnoses this rejection, not every possible future provisioning failure.
A newly selected qualification task is a separate descriptive treatment, never pooled with the old selection or campaign.
Legacy current-version data fields remain supported only when the exact GET exposes them and they match the frozen tuple; runtime readback remains mandatory.
